reasoning_traces.think:
The FanDuel Research platform synthesizes real-time sports data into actionable intelligence by applying Bayesian inference to expert commentary and historical performance metrics. The system's core operates on a dual framework: one layer computes probabilistic forecasts based on conditional likelihoods derived from past events, while another layer models strategic decisions within finite state games. Both layers rely on consistent data formatting and temporal alignment to maintain coherence. Failure modes include data corruption leading to incorrect posteriors or insufficient state representation causing suboptimal strategy selection. Dualities emerge between statistical inference and game-theoretic planning, where each informs the other through feedback loops.
